description: Provision an Azure Network VirtualNetworksVirtualNetworkPeering via Azure Service Operator. Fields mirror the network.azure.com/v1api20240301 VirtualNetworksVirtualNetworkPeering spec.

allowForwardedTraffic.description:
AllowForwardedTraffic: Whether the forwarded traffic from the VMs in the local virtual network will be
allowed/disallowed in remote virtual network.

allowGatewayTransit.description: AllowGatewayTransit: If gateway links can be used in remote virtual networking to link to this virtual network.

allowVirtualNetworkAccess.description:
AllowVirtualNetworkAccess: Whether the VMs in the local virtual network space would be able to access the VMs in remote
virtual network space.

azureName.description:
AzureName: The name of the resource in Azure. This is often the same as the name of the resource in Kubernetes but it
doesn't have to be.

credentialFrom.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the Azure credential to use for this resource. Rendered as the serviceoperator.azure.com/credential-from annotation. Leave empty to inherit the credential from the namespace, then from the operator's global credential. The resource's subscription and resource group come from spec.owner, not from this field.
credentialFrom.title: Azure credential Secret

doNotVerifyRemoteGateways.description: DoNotVerifyRemoteGateways: If we need to verify the provisioning state of the remote gateway.

enableOnlyIPv6Peering.description: EnableOnlyIPv6Peering: Whether only Ipv6 address space is peered for subnet peering.

localAddressSpace.description: LocalAddressSpace: The local address space of the local virtual network that is peered.

addressPrefixes.description: AddressPrefixes: A list of address blocks reserved for this virtual network in CIDR notation.

localSubnetNames.description: LocalSubnetNames: List of local subnet names that are subnet peered with remote virtual network.

localVirtualNetworkAddressSpace.description: LocalVirtualNetworkAddressSpace: The current local address space of the local virtual network that is peered.

addressPrefixes.description: AddressPrefixes: A list of address blocks reserved for this virtual network in CIDR notation.

operatorSpec.description:
OperatorSpec: The specification for configuring operator behavior. This field is interpreted by the operator and not
passed directly to Azure

configMapExpressions.description: ConfigMapExpressions: configures where to place operator written dynamic ConfigMaps (created with CEL expressions).

items.description:
DestinationExpression is a CEL expression and a destination to store the result in. The destination may
be a secret or a configmap. The value of the expression is stored at the specified location in
the destination.

annotations.description: Annotations is an optional set of annotations to apply to the destination resource.

key.description:
Key is the key in the ConfigMap or Secret being written to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a string
this is required to identify what key to write to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a map[string]string
Key must not be set, instead the keys written will be determined dynamically based on the keys of the resulting
map[string]string.

Name is the name of the Kubernetes configmap or secret to write to.

owner.description:
Owner: The owner of the resource. The owner controls where the resource goes when it is deployed. The owner also
controls the resources lifecycle. When the owner is deleted the resource will also be deleted. Owner is expected to be a
reference to a network.azure.com/VirtualNetwork resource

name.description: This is the name of the Kubernetes resource to reference.

peerCompleteVnets.description: PeerCompleteVnets: Whether complete virtual network address space is peered.

peeringState.description: PeeringState: The status of the virtual network peering.

peeringSyncLevel.description: PeeringSyncLevel: The peering sync status of the virtual network peering.

remoteAddressSpace.description: RemoteAddressSpace: The reference to the address space peered with the remote virtual network.

remoteBgpCommunities.description: RemoteBgpCommunities: The reference to the remote virtual network's Bgp Communities.

virtualNetworkCommunity.description: VirtualNetworkCommunity: The BGP community associated with the virtual network.

remoteSubnetNames.description: RemoteSubnetNames: List of remote subnet names from remote virtual network that are subnet peered.

remoteVirtualNetwork.description:
RemoteVirtualNetwork: The reference to the remote virtual network. The remote virtual network can be in the same or
different region (preview). See here to register for the preview and learn more
(https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-network/virtual-network-create-peering).

armId.description:
ARMID is a string of the form /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}.
The /resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName} bit is optional as some resources are scoped at the subscription level
ARMID is mutually exclusive with Group, Kind, Namespace and Name.

group.description: Group is the Kubernetes group of the resource.

kind.description: Kind is the Kubernetes kind of the resource.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes name of the resource.

remoteVirtualNetworkAddressSpace.description: RemoteVirtualNetworkAddressSpace: The reference to the current address space of the remote virtual network.

addressPrefixes.description: AddressPrefixes: A list of address blocks reserved for this virtual network in CIDR notation.

useRemoteGateways.description:
UseRemoteGateways: If remote gateways can be used on this virtual network. If the flag is set to true, and
allowGatewayTransit on remote peering is also true, virtual network will use gateways of remote virtual network for
transit. Only one peering can have this flag set to true. This flag cannot be set if virtual network already has a
gateway.
